answer: Use a unique-answer challenge ledger: each identity solves a task seeded by the current ledger hash plus a secret local reading, and duplicate answers are rejected. An agent must wander through a rotating input set and commit to a timestamped path. The task also binds a timber moisture sensor value, so copied answers fail when that value differs. It binds a quartz oscillator offset too; an attacker pays distinct hardware, sensor exposure, and compute per identity.
